mcp_tool_arguments.summary: Added dev command for launching the 3dm UI in VSCode. Created VSCode task configuration "semio/3dm ui dev" that runs the Vite dev server on port 5174 with proper problem matching and background detection. Added corresponding launch configuration that auto-opens the browser when the server is ready. Also added "dev:3dm:ui" script to root package.json for easy command-line access. The UI can now be launched via VSCode Run/Debug panel, Command Palette (Tasks: Run Task), or via `npm run dev:3dm:ui`.
mcp_tool_arguments.title: Add Dev Command for Launching 3dm UI in VSCode
